TEXT: I didn't pay attention in class all the way up until when school ended.
It isn't bad to do something else once in a while after lessons or tests but...
Wearing my uniform and playing soccer, how did this happen?
...I don't feel like playing though. I'll just find some corner and idle away.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Hey Kousaka. Don't space out. The ball's coming!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh, Akagi. I'm deep in thought right now. So don't mind me.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So just pretend like I'm not here and play your soccer, former soccer team member.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: What are you saying? You better come around when we get the ball.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah yeah, whatever you say, just go. Don't bother me.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Geez, I already made it clear, alright?
Well, that aside... how can I find a way to start a conversation with Kuroneko?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Hey, Kousaka! The ball is going in your direction!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Guaaaaaaaaaaah!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Hey! Kousaka! Are you all right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Owowowowowow...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: After eating that right in the face, of course it hurts.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Hey, aren't you being too coldhearted?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Who and where is that fellow who wasted my beautiful pass?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Besides it was your fault for spacing out. Normally you could have avoided that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Guh...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Well, take a break for now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Y-Yeah. Thanks...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Well, come back to the field if it doesn't hurt anymore.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Haha, this is nothing. It'll be healed in no time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Tch, that bastard...
Wait... Huh? Over by the pool...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Are you for real......
God, if you exist, please accept my gratitude!
I knew you've been watching all this time, and now you decided to reward me!
Aahh. She hid herself...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Hey! The ball is coming at you again!
But it's too late! Your rare image has already been engraved into my retinas!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Guuuuaaaah～～!!
Not again... Owowoww.
Is this my punishment for seeing Kuroneko in her swimsuit...

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: Hey, I'm really sorry. It wasn't on purpose this time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You again～～!!
